en: Il pleut means it is raining.
How do you say “It is snowing” in French?
It is snowing is il neige. La neige is the snow.
Chaud means hot, so il fait chaud means it is hot.
How do you say “It is cold” in French?
Froid means cold: il fait froid.
Il fait beau means the weather is nice.
How do you say “It is windy” in French?
Le vent is the wind, so it is windy is il y a du vent.
What does “Il y a du soleil” mean?
Le soleil is the sun, so il y a du soleil means it is sunny.
How do you say “It is foggy” in French?
Le brouillard is fog: il y a du brouillard.
What does “Il y a des nuages” mean?
Les nuages are clouds, so it means it is cloudy.
How do you say “There is a storm” in French?
L’orage is a storm: il y a de l’orage.
How do you ask “What is the weather like?” in French?
Quel temps fait-il ? asks about the weather. Quelle heure est-il ? asks the time.
How do you say “the snow” in French?
How do you say “the wind” in French?
“Il neige !” What can you build outside?
Il neige means it is snowing, so you can build a snowman.
Il pleut means it is raining, so an umbrella keeps you dry.
“Il fait chaud.” What do you wear?
Il fait chaud means it is hot, so a sun hat is best.
“Il fait froid.” What do you wear?
Il fait froid means it is cold, so you wrap up in a scarf.
Grey clouds and drops of water are falling. What do you say?
Drops of water falling is rain: il pleut.
It is a bright, warm day at the beach. Which fits?
A bright, warm day is nice weather: il fait beau.
Snow is likely in winter. Very hot days and swimming in the sea are for summer.
Mauvais means bad, so the weather is bad.
Froid means cold, so il fait froid means it is cold.
The weather is nice: Il ___ beau.
For the weather French uses il fait: il fait beau.
It is sunny: Il y a du ___.
The sun is le soleil, so it is sunny is il y a du soleil.
Un arc-en-ciel is a rainbow. Ciel means sky.
How do you say “It is very hot” in French?
Très means very, so it is very hot is il fait très chaud.
Which French word is a weather word?
La neige (snow) is weather. La table is a table and le chat is a cat.

example.why_en: Il pleut means it is raining.

en.title: The weather in French
en.teach: To talk about the weather in French we often say il fait: il fait beau (it is nice), il fait chaud (it is hot), il fait froid (it is cold). Rain and snow are il pleut and il neige.
